ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In the food web diagram, what is the producer?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the food web diagram, the upper left side is labeled “Filamentous Algae”, and the upper left-of-center is also labeled “Diatoms and other Phytoplankton”. At these plant-like/algae labels, there are arrows pointing to consumers such as zooplankton, insect larvae, snails, fish, and crayfish. Reasoning: Producers are organisms that can make their own food through photosynthesis and serve as the starting point of a food web. In the diagram, the ones that fit this role are algae. Therefore, the producers are algae.
